items.title: The lower shriek along the projection to the point is a left inverse of the pullback when the site has an initial or a final object
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the situation of the example of the category mapping to the point, if the site has an initial or a final object then the composite of the lower shriek with the pullback is the identity on the derived category of abelian groups, respectively of B-modules (statement lines 10188-10193). The proof (proof lines 10195-10206) disposes of the initial object case by evaluating the shriek, then uses the evaluation of the pushforward on a final object to obtain Rpi_* pi^{-1} = id and concludes by the formal criterion for full faithfulness of an adjoint. H2: two cases with one formal adjunction step, written out in full.
